name: maplestack
description: Search open jobs in Canada, collected directly from employer career pages. Find jobs by role, skill, company and location, filter for remote work, recent postings or a minimum salary, open any result for its full details, and ask for MapleStack's daily email of new jobs in Canada.

interface.longDescription:
Search open jobs in Canada, collected directly from employer career pages.

Ask for a role, a skill or a company in any city or province. Filter for remote work, recent postings or a minimum salary. Results show the most recent matches, with salary where the employer states it.

Open any result for its full details, or paste a MapleStack job link to check whether it is still open. Every job links to its page on MapleStack, where you apply.

You can also ask for MapleStack's daily email of new jobs in Canada. A confirmation link is sent first, and nothing else is sent unless you click it.

No account needed. Covers jobs in Canada only.
defaultPrompt: Find software developer jobs in Toronto.
Any remote data analyst jobs in Canada posted this week?
Show me nursing jobs in Ottawa.
